Under the {wiki:Ancient Temple} of Thais, two {creature:Dragon|Dragons} guard their treasure on an island surrounded by lava. Cross the floors full of orcs, kill the dragons, put out the fire covering a hole and use it to receive 6 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies}.
Some fierce dragons guard their treasure with fire.
to leave the dragon island and climb back up through the hole on floor -2
at least 1 charge, to put out the fire over the hole
If you are not a high level, lure the dragons one at a time to the rope spot and kill them there.
Sometimes there are creatures lured by other players ({creature:Bonelord}, {creature:Fire Devil}, {creature:Orc Berserker}). Stay alert.
1. Going down through the Ancient Temple
Leave **Thais** through the north gate: the {wiki:Ancient Temple} is right **northwest** of that gate. Enter and go down the two flights of stairs.

Follow the pink line from A to B: head **south** through the first door, then **west** along the corridor to a second door facing south. Go through it and continue **south** past the first junction. At the second junction head **east**. Continue **south**: there are one or two {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Go down the hole on the **east** side.
Path on floor -2 (from A to B)

As you go down, prepare for several {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} (sometimes as many as seven). Follow the route from A to B: **south** and then **northwest**, until you see stairs going down with fire beneath them. There are no monsters down there: go down.
Path on floor -3 (from A to B)
Follow the line. You do not need to step on the fire fields: walk around them. Continue **south** until you see a hole.

Beneath the hole there are 2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} on an island surrounded by {item:Lava}, with fire fields. Lure them to the rope spot and kill them one at a time. If you are a high level or with friends, you can simply kill them on the island.
The dragons breathe fire and hit hard on low levels. Use the rope to escape if needed.
Put out the fire in the hole

Go down to the island covered in fire. On the **east** side of the island there is a fire covering a hole (the hole shows up as a yellow dot on the minimap). Use the {item:Destroy Field} rune on that fire to leave only the hole.
Hole covered by fire on the east side of the island
**Use** the hole (click with "Use"): it is not for going down. You receive 6 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies}.
Go back to the rope spot (the place beneath the hole you came down to the island by) and use the {item:Rope} to climb to floor -4.
Without a {item:Rope} you get stuck on the dragon island.

Do the route in reverse: on floor -4 head back **north** to the stairs and go up to -3; on -3 go back to the hole you fell through and use the {item:Rope} to climb to -2; on -2 return to the stairs and go up the two flights to the temple entrance. Use the images from section 1 in reverse (from B to A).
Outside you are right northwest of the north gate of Thais.
